top.p1: Panoramic, passenger, home and service elevators, designed, installed and maintained across the Kingdom by a team that has completed more than ten thousand installations. Enjoy your journey.
about.h21: A trusted name in vertical transport
about.p2: Headquartered in Riyadh, SKYLINE has spent 46 years building a reputation for quality, safety and reliability, with more than 10,000 successful elevator installations across the Kingdom.
about.p3: Since its founding, SKYLINE has been committed to delivering the highest quality products and services to its customers. Our team of expert technicians is dedicated to the best possible customer service, with a focus on safety and reliability, making SKYLINE the preferred choice for residential and commercial projects in cities throughout Saudi Arabia.
about.p4: The Saudi elevator market continues to grow with the Kingdom's expanding construction industry and its appetite for modern, high-quality buildings. As a local company, SKYLINE meets that demand with products and services built to international standards and backed by a nationwide branch network.
types.p2: From glass panoramic cars to compact home lifts and heavy-duty service elevators, every SKYLINE system is engineered for its building and finished to the client's request.
t_pano.p1: A revolutionary concept in elevator design.
t_pano.p2: Panorama elevators offer a unique and innovative experience for riders. Walls and ceilings made entirely of glass provide a stunning 360-degree view of the surrounding area.
t_pano.p3: They redefine the way people perceive vertical transportation, providing breathtaking views and a sense of openness during the ride. Ideal for atriums, malls, hotels and signature residences.
t_mr.p1: Experience and enjoy the quiet, efficient lift of MR elevators.
t_mr.p2: Machine-Room (MR) elevators are known for their quiet operation, durability and energy-saving capabilities. Commonly used in taller buildings, they employ traction systems with ropes and counterweights.
t_mr.p3: They incorporate advanced safety features and technology such as emergency braking systems and smart monitoring, with well-ventilated machine rooms to dissipate heat.
t_mrl.p2: MRL elevators are a cost-effective, space-saving solution designed to eliminate the need for a separate machine room, freeing valuable floor area in the building.
t_mrl.p3: Compact gearless traction systems power the cabin for smooth, quiet rides, backed by emergency braking and redundant safety systems. A popular choice for residential and commercial buildings alike.
t_home.p1: The convenient solution for multi-level living.
t_home.p2: Home lifts greatly improve accessibility and convenience in a multi-storey home, and are especially beneficial for elderly or mobility-impaired residents.
t_home.p3: Each lift is customised to fit the style and layout of the specific home, blending seamlessly with the interior while offering a practical, stylish solution for multi-storey living.
t_service.p1: Efficient and reliable: streamlining building operations.
t_service.p2: Hospital elevators enhance patient comfort and safety, the perfect solution for medical facilities and the swift movement of staff and patients.
t_service.p3: Cargo elevators are the ultimate solution for heavy loads and large items in warehouses and industrial buildings.
t_service.p4: Dumb waiters elevate kitchen efficiency, offering discreet transfer of meals and supplies in restaurants and hotels.
t_int.p1: Exploring modern, classic and steel-inspired cabins.
t_int.p2: Modern cabins incorporate sleek lines, minimalist aesthetics and high-quality materials such as glass, stainless steel and polished surfaces, creating a contemporary, sophisticated ambience.
t_int.p3: Classic designs embrace timeless elegance with ornate details, rich wood finishes and intricate carvings, evoking a sense of luxury and tradition.
styles.p2: Every component is a design choice. Hover a category to preview the sample sheets from our 2023 catalogue, or click to open them.
styles.p3: Panoramic, sliding and swinging doors for safety and efficiency.
styles.p4: Painted steel and acrylic ceilings with LED lamps.
styles.p5: Decorative panels that finish the cabin with a polished, cohesive look.
styles.p6: Reflective decor that opens up the cabin and brightens the ride.
styles.p7: Durable flooring in a wide range of materials and patterns.
styles.p8: Control panels and indicators for improved cabin functionality.
styles.p9: Stainless steel in silver, gold and bronze finishes.
styles.p10: Geared and gearless drives that power the movement of the car.
styles.p11: Measures that ensure the protection of passengers.
styles.p12: Strict protocols, inspections and testing for secure operation.
styles.p14: Unlock your creative potential. Pick your doors, panels, ceiling and floor, then bring your vision to life one floor at a time. Send the design straight to our team for a quote.
designs.p2: From elegant and sophisticated to modern and contemporary, our cabins combine quality materials, ergonomic layouts and attention to detail. Explore for inspiration.
tours.p2: Virtual tours of real SKYLINE installations. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, and switch between samples on the left.
maintenance.p2: Certified elevator maintenance under annual contracts designed to give you comprehensive support. Our team is certified in civil defence protocols, so your elevators meet safety regulations, and a fast-response action plan means help is only a call away, day or night.
maintenance.p7: Our team is certified in civil defence protocols and safety regulations.
downloads.p2: Explore our offerings, specifications and collaboration opportunities. For any assistance, reach out to our team.
faq.p2: Quick answers to common enquiries. If you need anything else, our knowledgeable team is here to help.
faq.summary1: 01What types of elevators do you offer?
faq.div1: We offer a wide range of elevators, including passenger elevators, freight elevators, home elevators, panoramic elevators and more. Our elevators are designed to meet various needs and requirements.
faq.summary2: 02Do you provide annual maintenance contracts?
faq.div2: Yes. Our comprehensive yearly maintenance contracts ensure regular inspections, preventative maintenance and prompt support, allowing for smooth and reliable elevator operation throughout the year.
faq.summary3: 03Are your elevators compliant with safety standards and regulations?
faq.div3: Absolutely. Our company is certified in civil defence and our elevators are manufactured to meet or exceed industry safety standards and comply with all relevant regulations. Safety is a core aspect of our elevator solutions.
faq.summary4: 04Can you customise elevators to suit specific building requirements?
faq.div4: Yes, we specialise in tailored elevator solutions. Our team works closely with clients to understand their unique needs and customise elevator designs accordingly, ensuring seamless integration with the building structure.
faq.summary5: 05What is the typical lead time for supply and installation?
faq.div5: Lead time varies with the scope of the project, building requirements and elevator type. Normally supply takes 60 to 100 days and installation 7 to 15 days. Our team will assess your specific needs and provide a detailed timeline during consultation.
faq.summary6: 06Do you offer after-sales support and warranty?
faq.div6: Yes. We provide 2 years of comprehensive after-sales support and warranty coverage for our elevators. Our customer service team is available to assist with any queries or concerns even after installation is complete.
faq.summary7: 07How can I request a quote or schedule a consultation?
faq.div7: Simply fill out the contact form below or call us on the unified number 9200 28880. Our sales representatives will promptly assist you and guide you through the next steps.
faq.summary8: 08What measures ensure sustainable, eco-friendly solutions?
faq.div8: We incorporate energy-efficient technologies such as LED lighting and regenerative drives to minimise environmental impact, and prioritise recyclable and eco-friendly materials in our manufacturing processes.
faq.summary9: 09Do you offer 24/7 emergency support for breakdowns?
faq.div9: Absolutely. We provide round-the-clock emergency support to address any unexpected breakdowns or malfunctions promptly, minimising downtime.
contact.p2: For enquiries, project support or a quotation, our dedicated team offers prompt and personalised assistance. We look forward to serving your vertical transportation needs.
